Name: Purrito Plushies
Author: AvatarKitten
Description:
[size=4]Another cat themed mod from me? Shocking.[/size]

[size=4]This mod adds in a full set of all 18 (currently) Purrito plushies by Uncute. The plushies can be obtained by purchasing a catalogue from Robin for 1000 G. So cute and cozy![/size]

[size=4][b]MODS REQUIRED:[/b][/size]
[size=4]Calcifer [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20628]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20628[/url][/size]
[size=4]Content Patcher [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][b]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915[/b][/url][/size]

[size=4]All art was created by me, and was based off the existing Purrito plushies line by Uncute. [/size]

[size=4]Thank you to the Stardew Valley Discord mod making channel for helping me troubleshoot.[/size]

[size=4]Thank you to vikich3rry (Paimon Catalogue) and slumberwood (Slumberwood's Webkinz), as I read through their code as a guideline for creating my own catalogue for this mod.[/size]

[size=4]Cursor in mod image is from Cat Valley Interface by RimeNovi.[/size]
